items.title: Ghostty-based terminal with vertical tabs and notifications

I was using Ghostty with a bunch of split panes, and relying on native macOS notifications to know when an agent needed me. items.title: What makes AI agent runtime logs defensible under adversarial audit?
items.raw_excerpt: Modern AI agents can execute tools, write to databases, and trigger irreversible actions. Most teams rely on traditional logging (OpenTelemetry, SIEM, DB audit logs). But under adversarial conditions (audit, litigation, incident response), those logs depend on platform trust and cannot typically be verified independently of the system that produced them. I’m exploring whether agent runtime evidence should be: -deterministically canonicalized -hash-chained -signed -optionally externally timestamped -verifiable offline The goal isn’t observability. It’s defensibility.
